notes: `gate=true` means CI fails if the measured value exceeds `target`.
`gate=false` means the metric is measured + reported but not enforced yet.
Comparison is `<=` for every entry (lower is better).
M2.5 gates the four metrics measurable today; object-op metrics flip to gate=true in M3 when PutObject/GetObject land.

metrics.label: Cold start to bound listener
metrics.how: process spawn -> `--self-test-ready` exits cleanly; median of 5 runs

metrics.label: Idle RSS (5 s after start, no traffic)
metrics.how: max of 3 samples 1 s apart, read from `/proc/<pid>/status` VmRSS

metrics.label: Wipe-restart (kill --ephemeral then back up)
metrics.how: kill running --ephemeral instance, respawn, time to first TCP accept; median of 5 runs

metrics.label: Warm p50 PutObject (1 KB body)
metrics.how: M3 activates: 10k sequential PutObject ops via aws-sdk-go-v2, 50th percentile

informational_metrics.label: Warm p50 HeadBucket
informational_metrics.how: 10k sequential HeadBucket ops via aws-sdk-go-v2, 50th percentile
